title: Tally crumbs — devlog & quick run sheet
content:
Purpose: tiny, portable tracker for ad-hoc runs (quick comparisons of batch/kv/quant effects).

How I use this: paste a row per run, keep only the essentials so I can eyeball regressions on a single page. Copy into personal repo notebook for longer analysis.

Quick legend: model=family+size, topk conv = experimental top-k pruning, q=quantization (fp16/int8/q4x), KV=prefix cache on/off, seq=sequence length tested. Cost formula below.

| date | run | model | q | KV | batch | seq | tok/sec | p95_ms | cost_per_1k_tokens | notes |
|------|-----|-------|---|----|-------|-----|---------:|-------:|------------------:|-------|
| 2024-10-03 | r001 | redwood-v1-7B | fp16 | off | 1 | 128 | 420 | 78 | $0.86 | baseline, noisy cluster |
| 2024-10-04 | r002 | redwood-v1-7B | int8 | off | 1 | 128 | 760 | 52 | $0.49 | int8 artifact around names |
| 2024-10-05 | r003 | redwood-v1-7B | int8 | on | 1 | 128 | 980 | 46 | $0.38 | cache helps steady p95 |
| 2024-10-09 | r008 | redwood-v1-13B | fp16 | on | 2 | 256 | 640 | 120 | $1.90 | higher variance, temp SLO fail |
| 2024-10-12 | r014 | redwood-v1-7B | q4x | on | 4 | 64 | 2200 | 34 | $0.27 | q4x + cache = sweet spot for small seq |
| 2024-10-20 | r020 | redwood-v1-instr-7B | q4x | on | 2 | 512 | 540 | 98 | $0.33 | instruction tuning cost bump, mem pressure |

Notes / rough observations:
- KV cache yields ~25-40% p95 improvement for repetitive prefixes in these runs (r002 -> r003).
- Quant: int8 improves throughput but occasionally injects short hallucination artifacts in entity recall (log to eval set). q4x seems safe for short sequences.
- Batch >1 helps throughput but watch p95 tail — set burst policy in Dedicated to avoid SLO miss.

Handy calc: cost_per_1k_tokens = (instance_hour_cost / (tok_per_sec * 3600)) * 1000.
Example: instance $3.5/hr, tok/sec 760 -> cost = (3.5 / (760*3600)) * 1000 ≈ $0.49.

Open TODOs (short):
- [ ] Re-run r014 with different kernel selection (winograd vs default) — check p95.
- [ ] Add a small eval prompt set (10 prompts) to catch int8 recall errors automatically.
- [ ] Confirm Dedicated autoscale settings for bursts >4x baseline.

Quick copy-paste checklist for next run:
- seed=42, deterministic kernels on/off, expose kernel name in logs, prefix-caching TTL=30s, collect p50/p95/p99 + memory sample.

Slack shorthand for results post: "tally-crumbs r020: q4x+KV 2x batch -> 2.2k tok/s for short seq, p95 34ms, est $0.27/1k"

Random scribbles: calibrate cost model for Dedicated pricing (committed discount) vs hosted API unit economics. Track model variants under /repo/benchmarks/exp-index.csv (local copy).

End of sheet.
